hero.title: What's happening at PubliX
hero.sub: Acquisitions, partnerships and milestones from PubliX Group and the companies in the portfolio.

cards.title: PubliX Group acquires Bleau A/S and enters the Danish market
cards.excerpt: Bleau, the Aarhus company behind moliri, becomes the sixth company in PubliX Group and its first in Denmark. It keeps its name and its management.

cards.title: PubliX Group appoints Alexander Hübel as CEO
cards.excerpt: Alexander Hübel has been appointed Group CEO of PubliX Group, bringing extensive experience in scaling technology companies and building platforms in the Nordic market.

cards.title: Sotender launches in Sweden: Suomikoti is first customer
cards.excerpt: Finnish SaaS platform Sotender enters the Swedish market. Suomikoti, a Finnish-speaking care home in Enskede with 53 places, becomes the first Swedish customer.

cards.title: PubliX Group partners with Embrace Safety
cards.excerpt: A powerful SaaS platform enabling knowledge-based crime prevention and safety promotion for municipalities and local authorities.

cards.title: PubliX Group partners with Koivu Solutions (Sotender)
cards.excerpt: A modern SaaS solution for connecting healthcare workers with open shifts, increasing reach and reducing costs for healthcare providers.

cards.title: PubliX Group enters Finland through partnership with Aspicore
cards.excerpt: A full-service software provider within grant management, marking PubliX Group's expansion into the Finnish market.

cards.title: PubliX Group partners with digiPlant
cards.excerpt: A market leader within application management systems for foundations, strengthening PubliX's position in the grant management vertical.

cards.title: PubliX Group welcomes Tidvis
cards.excerpt: Strengthening digital care solutions in the Nordics: Tidvis develops platforms for social services, helping municipalities manage case work and compliance.

cta.title: Thinking about your next chapter?
cta.sub: Maybe you're exploring your options, or just want to talk to someone who understands your market. We'd welcome the conversation.
